x_failures: Quotes the Ikhwān soul seeking to escape the "fetters of nature and the darkness of the bodily world", but that phrase is not on p.102, which only says the soul "longs to ascend into the world of the spheres."
y_failures: Ascribes Ibn Tufayl's "voluntary Agent of ultimate perfection" (Philosophus Autodidactus p.138) to the Ikhwān al-Ṣafāʾ. Quotes "divine mechanism", which is not on p.136. Cites p.131 for "Heavenly Leveling (Tian Ni)", which appears only on p.65.
reason: X's Zhuangzi quotations from pp.131, 112 and 55 and its Dieterici 'man in the large' claim all match the pages; it has only one invented phrase. Y has a strong Autumn Floods quotation but several misattributions, including presenting a Hayy ibn Yaqzan passage as Ikhwān doctrine, so X is better grounded.
